opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Maximum grant available in categories: up to £20,000 (New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Long-Term Research); up to £5,000 (Conferences, Lectures and Publications); up to £2,500 (Research and Travel grants for individuals)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences, Lectures and Publications, Long‑Term Research; individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) for Research and Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Supports the growth and development of sculpture through grants for exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, publications, conferences and extended research projects, as well as research‑and‑travel funding for individual scholars.
